text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training for the Make Debut is progressing 
smoothly for Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, I want to be of even more 
help to her. Thinking that, I went to a 
family restaurant to brainstorm training 
menus, and then—"
...Huh? Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Turning around at the voice, Cheval Grand 
and an unfamiliar Umamusume wearing a blue 
hair accessory were sitting in a booth in 
the back.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry... For calling out to 
you out of the blue...
choice_data_list: It's okay. Are you here with your friends?
Are you okay? Are you with your friends?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes. She is... um—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Could I call her... my childhood 
friend, I wonder...?"

Wait, childhood friends...? I always 
thought of Cheval-chan as my best 
friend...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, sorry, just kidding. —Nice to meet 
you, Trainer. My name is Shine Praise.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I used to run with Cheval-chan back when 
we were little in the junior club.
choice_data_list: Nice to meet you, nice to have you!

Nice to meet you, looking forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A junior club is a development facility 
where Umamusume who aim to enter official 
races in the future gather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Varying in size, they exist all over the 
country, and many Umamusume at Tracen 
Academy belonged to one during their 
childhood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The childhood friend I was introduced to 
was one grade above me, and apparently had 
made her debut last year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She gives off a gentle and easygoing 
impression, so she seems like a great 
match for the reserved Cheval Grand.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
When Cheval-chan joined the junior club, I 
instantly wanted to become friends with 
her—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
When we were greeting each other, she was 
trembling nervously, but her running in 
the mock race was so confident and 
dignified...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help calling out to her. 
"You're amazing! Let's run together!" I 
said.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan was really such a good girl! 
She was always the last one to leave 
self-training.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
She's serious, hates losing— and I fell in 
love with her in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: P-Please stop... ...I-It's embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Shine was the one who was amazing... She 
was strong, and so kind to someone like 
me..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Because Shine was there, I feel like... I 
was able to do my best even at the new 
club..."
choice_data_list: A new club?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! It's nothing... really.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand hurriedly shook her head, 
leaving me with a sense of unease.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, speaking of the 
junior club, Cheval Grand's older and 
younger sisters were supposed to be 
members as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, Cheval-chan, did 
you tell your club coach about your debut?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh? N-No, I haven't. Besides, I doubt 
they'd even remember someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, I don't think that's true. Sure, 
there were a lot of students, but I'm sure 
they'd be happy if you taught them.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... B-But... it's embarrassing... More 
importantly, Shine, lately you've—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could ask, the conversation 
drifted away, and in the end, I never got 
to hear about the club.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Still bothered by the 
strange feeling I had back then, I decided 
to look into it—
choice_data_list:
(She transferred to a different club, 
huh...)

(So she transferred to a different 
club...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Cheval Grand and her sisters 
all belonged to the same junior club when 
they were young.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, according to the records, within 
less than a year, Cheval Grand was the 
only one to transfer to another junior 
club.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew Cheval Grand was acutely conscious 
of her older sister Verxina and younger 
sister Vivlos, but this is—
choice_data_list:
(Was there a particular reason you decided 
to transfer?)

(Did something make you decide to 
transfer?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Yesterday brought back so many 
memories... It's been ages since I talked 
about the junior club...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Back then...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I found a dream... And no matter what, I 
just couldn't give up on chasing it...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(To think that someone like me... could 
actually believe I could do it—)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Now, the Arima Kinen heads into its final 
stage! Can anyone defeat this shockingly 
powerful, undefeated Triple Crown 
Umamusume—?!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A leap-like stride approaches rapidly 
from the outside! Passing the 200m mark, 
will she pull alongside, will she―― Oh, 
look at that!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And they won't reach her! She crosses the 
line!! A run of pure tenacity hands the 
undefeated 'Hero' her first defeat, 
seizing a magnificent maiden GⅠ 
victory—!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Yellow Racing Silk
text_block_list.text: "—Aaaaaaaagh!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: —She really is... incredible.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If only I could become a "great Umamusume" 
like this too...
choice_data_list:
I see, so "Greatness" had a role model 
after all.

I see, so "Greatness" had a role model, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa! T-T-Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Th-This isn't... w-well, no, it isn't 
wrong, but still...!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... O-Oh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I know it's presumptuous of me, but... 
This race is... really special to me...!
choice_data_list:
I remember it too. It was an incredible 
race.
I remember it too. It was an amazing race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the first place, that entire year was 
just one shock after another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hailed as a certain Triple Crown winner 
before the Satsuki Sho, a "Hero" was born, 
achieving it undefeated just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fervor in the racing world was 
immense— so much so that the final leg of 
the Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho, broke 
the all-time attendance record at Kyoto 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, she was the resounding favorite 
in the year-end Arima Kinen. No one 
doubted her victory. But the outcome was—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...That race... I was watching it at home 
together with big sis and Vivlos."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Those two have always been fans of the 
"Hero". On TV, in magazines, everyone 
believed the "Hero" was going to win—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: However... the result was different.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
While everyone believed the winner of the 
Arima was a "hero," there was an Umamusume 
quietly biding her time, sharpening her 
fangs.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
She fought and won her own place to 
belong. Never giving up... taking on 
challenge after challenge—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Like, "How's that, did you see that!?" 
...you know.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her scream with her whole body... 
my chest grew helplessly hot...
choice_data_list: So that became your dream, huh.
So that became your dream, didn't it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's too simple... isn't it? But once I 
found something to admire, I just couldn't 
stop...
choice_data_list:
So that's why you transferred junior clubs 
too?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's right. That very day, I 
asked my father and mother...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's not Big sis or Vivlos's fault. It's 
just that I... keep comparing myself to 
them and getting bothered by it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"So she said she wanted to go somewhere 
she could focus purely on running to get 
stronger."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The results were only so-so, though... 
Still, I was trying my absolute best back 
then...
choice_data_list: You're tough.
You're strong, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? N-No... I mean, someone like me 
really isn't...
choice_data_list:
You're strong for not running away from 
your dream.

You are strong for not running away from 
your dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I used to worry seeing her always look so 
out of place. Yet she had already gained 
the strength to choose her own path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Choosing where to dedicate her efforts, 
honing her abilities until she was ready 
to debut—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She does tend to look down on herself, and 
there are probably many moments where she 
feels frustrated with who she is. Even so—
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best so that I can be worthy of 
you too!
I'll work hard to become worthy of you!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh... Wh... Wh-Why did it turn into 
that kind of conversation...――"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san... It's me! I'm the one who 
needs to work hard... So... please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone says, Cheval Grand 
is strong. I knew that proving it to the 
world was my duty.
